t: This is Aldwych, a closed London Underground station near the Strand's junction with Surrey Street. It opened in 1907 under the name Strand, after the street it stands on. It was the end of the line for a short Piccadilly line branch from Holborn, a leftover from the merger of two railway schemes. Over the years there were several proposals to extend the tunnels south, usually to Waterloo, but none were built. The architect was Leslie Green, best known for the London stations he designed in the 1900s. They have oxblood red faïence blocks and tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
